summary: When you want something, you want it all the way, and you don't run out of fuel. Drive and raw power are fused in you, so your will can move mountains or start wars. There's no low setting.
body: When you want something, you want it all the way, and you don't run out of fuel. Drive and raw power are fused in you, so your will can move mountains or start wars. There's no low setting. Power may not feel neutral here. It can register as something tied to safety, control, and the need to protect yourself. You push with a force that can overwhelm people, or lock into struggles you can't walk away from. Aimed right, you're unstoppable, the one who does what takes real power. Aimed wrong, you burn the whole engine on a grudge. The work is pointing the force at transformation, not domination.
gift: At your best: unstoppable, regenerative, built for what flattens other people.
shadow: The trap: power struggles, compulsion, and a will that turns into a weapon.
integration: Let drive and anger and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Formidable drive; temper and overkill are the dangers.
do: Aim the force at a goal, not a person
Drop the fight you can't win clean
